title: Dumbbell Pullover
summary: A dumbbell pullover across a flat bench that works the lats and chest in a long, stretched position.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.8 for lats (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.5 for chest (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.3 for triceps (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.2 for upper back: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly upper back total.

setup.text: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
Keeping a slight elbow bend, lower the weight back behind your head until you feel a stretch in your lats and chest.
Pull it back over your chest in the same arc.

form_cues.cue: Keep a slight bend in the elbows
Lower the dumbbell behind your head
Tension drops off at the top, so stop just before the weight is over your face.

mistakes.text: Flaring the ribs and arching to get extra range.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
